requirements.title: Catalog serves what it was given
requirements.text: It should return a created product at the price it was given, and list it in the catalog.
requirements.happyPath: POST a product at 900 cents → 201 with priceCents 900; the product appears in GET /products.

requirements.title: Catalog SKU identity
requirements.text: It should derive a stable slug SKU from the product name, because that SKU is the identity inventory consumes.

requirements.title: Reserving consumes stock
requirements.text: It should reduce a SKU's available count by exactly the quantity reserved.

requirements.title: A discount reaches the total
requirements.text: It should apply the recorded discount percentage to the cart total the customer is charged.
requirements.happyPath: Two units at 1800 cents with WELCOME10 total 3240 cents.

requirements.title: Discount codes replace, never stack
requirements.text: It should let a second discount code replace the first rather than combining the two.
requirements.happyPath: Applying HALFOFF after WELCOME10 totals 1800 cents, not a combined 60% off.

requirements.title: An oversell is refused honestly
requirements.text: It should refuse a reservation larger than the stock on hand and report the count that is genuinely still available.
requirements.unhappyPath: Reserving 10000 of a SKU with 8 left returns 409 and the unchanged available count.

requirements.title: Unknown stock is a missing resource
requirements.text: It should refuse a reservation against a SKU that does not exist as a missing resource, not a malformed request.
requirements.unhappyPath: Reserving against an unknown SKU returns 404, not 400.

requirements.title: A price change persists
requirements.text: It should persist a product price update and return the product at its new price.
requirements.happyPath: PATCH priceCents 1800 → 2000 returns the product at 2000.

requirements.title: Reads agree with charges
requirements.text: It should report, when a cart is read back, the same total checkout will charge — discount included.
requirements.happyPath: Two units at 2000 cents with WELCOME10 read back as 3600 cents.

requirements.title: A deleted product is gone
requirements.text: It should remove the deleted product — and only that product — from the catalog listing.
requirements.happyPath: DELETE a product → 204, and it no longer appears in GET /products while its neighbours do.

requirements.title: A rejected code changes nothing
requirements.text: It should refuse an unknown discount code and leave the discount already on the cart intact.
requirements.unhappyPath: An unknown code returns 400 and the cart keeps the total its earlier valid code produced.

requirements.title: An empty order is refused
requirements.text: It should refuse to place a cart that has no items, and leave the cart open.
requirements.unhappyPath: Checking out an empty cart returns 409 and the cart status stays "open".
